import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { changesetComments } from "../../../backend/schema/changeset_comments";

export const changesetCommentsCms = customizeTable<typeof changesetComments>("changeset_comments", {
    icon: "MessageCircle",
    display: {
        title: "body"
    },
    fields: {
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "visible", "changeset", "author", "body", "createdAt"]
});
